clues: Most folks in this town live in a wide valley. High peaks rise on the west side of the town.
This high, dry town has cold winters and hot summers. Rain and snow are scarce for most of the year.
This town has been the capital since 1861, when the land was not yet a state. Its founder set land aside in its heart for a capitol.
For more than twenty years, a mint in this town stamped gold and silver coins. The coins came from rich mines in the hills.
The governor of Nevada works in this town. State lawmakers meet here, in a small town by the hills.
